description: Stable Image Services, a comprehensive suite of thirteen specialized image editing tools from Stability AI designed to accelerate professional creative workflows.  Stable Image Services enables granular control over image editing with a range of tools designed to work with your creative process, allowing you to take a single concept from ideation to finished product with precision and flexibility.  The Stable Image Erase service removes unwanted elements while intelligently maintaining background consistency, using image masks.
summary: Stable Image Services on Bedrock offer ready-to-use media generation and editing capabilities delivered through APIs. The Stable Image Erase service removes unwanted elements while intelligently maintaining background consistency, using image masks.
